title: rules.decision-log.dead-letter-action.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox, in the transaction of the step, whenever an operator asks to retry or resolve a dead-lettered decision, and whenever a second person approves or rejects that request (RLE-235). It names who, which decision and why. A dead-lettered decision is never deleted; these events and the rows of rle_decision_queue_event are its audit trail. The outbox row id is the event id. Carries the full event envelope. Additive changes only within v1.

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the step happened, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id, or the event id when the caller gave none.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

step.description: What happened: the operator asked for a retry or a resolve, or a second person approved or rejected the request.

reason.description: The reason given, 3 to 500 characters; null for an approval given without one.

examples.reason: Partition for February was missing; created by the DBA
